pull: Clue: Her sister was even more famous
photoNote: Musashi leaving Brunei in October 1944, probably 22 October, on her last voyage. Photographed by Tobei Shiraishi from the destroyer Isokaze. U.S. Naval History and Heritage Command NH 63473, public domain.
photoCredit: Musashi leaving Brunei on her last voyage, October 1944. NHHC NH 63473, public domain.
body:
Can you name this ship?

She left Brunei in October 1944, bound for the largest naval battle in history. On 24 October, American carrier planes caught her in the Sibuyan Sea.

The clue is on the card. Drop your guess below.
